rule.link: exterior door REFR XTEL -> interior door REFR -> its CELL
rule.shell: STAT/MSTT/SCOL ref within 12.0 m of the exterior door whose OBND diagonal is >= 2.5 m (boxes scaled by the reference): first one whose box holds the door, then one within 1.0 m of it, then one within 3.0 m (the larger OBND volume within each band), else the nearest pivot; building candidates within 3.0 m of the directory family of the target cell's room seed are preferred over all others; when several building candidates stand within 3.0 m, one whose box holds the door, with no other within 1.0 m, but has no wall within 1.0 m of the door's width (a doorway piece of its own directory family counts as its wall) is dropped while a walled one remains, then the candidates whose room ratio (the target cell's room plan over the candidate's plan at the reference scale) is inside 0.6-1.7 are the only ones kept when any is and all are measurable; only candidates of the building footprint class (scaled box plan sides >= 2.0 m, height >= 2.0 m, plan >= 6.0 m2), trim never
rule.placedScales: per kit shell asset: the scale of every worldspace reference placing it in the mined plugins (median, p10, p90, n); a shell is a STAT/MSTT/SCOL the shell rule may consider whose box at the median scale is of the building footprint class
rule.entrance: doorOffsetInShell: the exterior door in the shell's own frame
rule.interiorFamily: the directory with the most plan area (m2) of the cell's building-class structural pieces; of all its structural pieces when it has no building-class one
